news-4.title: Gwangyang Works sets world-leading casting speed on No. 3 continuous caster
news-4.body:
The No. 3 continuous caster at POSCO Gwangyang Works' No. 2 continuous casting plant recently achieved a world-leading casting speed, once again proving the excellence of POSCO's steelmaking technology.

A continuous caster is a facility that cools and solidifies molten steel into intermediate materials such as slabs; caster productivity is closely tied to Gwangyang Works' crude steel output. The record achieved this time is 2.7 m per minute based on a 250 mm slab thickness — a production increase of more than 35% over existing casters. Converted to a 220 mm slab thickness, the casting speed is 3.1 m per minute, surpassing the world record of 3.0 m for the same thickness set by Japan's JFE Steel. In addition, 270 tons of molten steel can now be fully cast within 27 minutes, so the refining stage of the preceding steelmaking process is also expected to accelerate.

Steelmaking department and research institute staff carried out rationalization work last November to raise facility efficiency, building an efficient production line incorporating POSCO's own technologies: optimized roll arrangement along the pass line, secured intensive cooling, and multi-function electromagnetic control of molten steel flow in the mold. Gwangyang Works plans to focus on maximum production of high-grade and strategic steels, backed by quality and technology development across upstream and downstream processes, to secure high quality on the No. 3 caster with its annual capacity of more than 3.5 million tons.

news-5.title: POSCO ranked best corporate image in Korea
news-5.body:
POSCO was selected by university students as the company with the best corporate image. In a survey of 1,041 university students on brand preference among Korea's top 100 companies conducted by the job portal JobKorea, POSCO ranked first in the 'best corporate image' category.

The survey covered nine questions — such as 'the company likely to have outstanding management policies' and 'the company whose members are likely of the highest caliber' — over ten days from the 20th of last month, targeting the top 100 companies by 2006 revenue. POSCO was chosen by 145 respondents (13.9%) as the company with the best image, followed by Samsung Electronics (10.7%), CJ (9.2%), SK (8.7%) and Korean Air (4.9%).

POSCO also placed second after Samsung Electronics in the categories 'company that contributed most to national economic development' (14.7%) and 'company likely to have a good working environment' (11.5%), and ranked at the top across all survey items, confirming students' recognition of its role in Korea's economic growth and its cultivation of employee capability.

news-6.title: Large companies must not ignore realistic supply pricing
news-6.body:
Small and medium-sized manufacturers are being pushed into deficit management by soaring raw material prices; the foundry industry plans to halt deliveries on the 7th unless large customers act.

SMEs face the worst of conditions. Years of surging raw material prices have pushed them beyond deteriorating profitability to the point of stopping their plants. With high oil prices and a falling exchange rate already eroding margins, raw material costs are now dragging them into deficit. SMEs cannot reflect increases in materials, labor and prices in their product prices, so the situation is expected to worsen. In particular, large companies have ignored SMEs' demands for realistic supply prices or even pressed for price cuts, angering smaller firms; some industries are moving toward halting deliveries to large customers.

On February 29, the day before President Lee Myung-bak's planned first livelihood visit to an SME, foundry-industry CEOs gathered in Yeouido, Seoul, for the regular general meeting of the Korea Foundry Cooperative (chairman Suh Byung-moon). After the meeting they put on red headbands reading 'realistic supply prices' and adopted a resolution stating that unless customers take price normalization measures by March 7, they would not rule out returning their business registrations and halting deliveries. They declared the foundry industry faces its most serious management crisis since founding.

news-7.title: Gwangyang No. 1 hot rolling plant reaches 100 million tons of hot-rolled coil
news-7.body:
The No. 1 hot rolling plant at Gwangyang Works achieved the milestone of 100 million tons of hot-rolled coil in the shortest time for a single plant, showcasing Gwangyang's technological capability at home and abroad.

The plant, which began operation in February 1987 with a 2.7-million-ton production system, reached 100 million tons on the 25th of this month — 21 years and 1 month after completion, the fastest in POSCO's history. Converted to length (based on 2.7 mm thickness and 1,170 mm width), 100 million tons of coil is a little over 4 million kilometers — enough to build 100 million one-ton cars, make 9,891 round trips between Seoul and Busan, or wrap around the Earth 101 times.

Having proven itself the world's top hot rolling plant with 6.1 million tons of output for two consecutive years, the plant has improved product quality through QSS on-the-spot practice, lifelong learning and standardization, raised continuity between processes, and developed technology to shorten coil-to-coil production time. Plant manager Lim Chae-sik said the achievement was the result of employees' tireless efforts to meet growing demand for automotive steel sheet and high-grade steel, and pledged world-class performance in production, quality and cost toward completing a specialized automotive-steel works.

news-8.title: Integrated portal POSCOWAY.net opens
news-8.body:
Marking its 40th anniversary, POSCO is opening 'POSCOWAY.net', a portal for sharing the Global POSCO Way management philosophy and a range of management information across the POSCO family.

Officially operating from April 1, POSCOWAY.net brings POSCO and its invested companies together on the web with the goal of integrated value management, connecting people, information and systems under the Global POSCO Way philosophy. Any employee of the POSCO family can access information ranging from Global POSCO Way materials to CEO messages, company news and industry trends, and freely exchange know-how and ideas.

news-9.title: Green light for orders — POSCO E&E (Pocheol Kiyeon)
news-9.body:
▶ Blast-furnace PCI, mini-mill electric arc furnace, roof-top solar power — equipment orders at Pocheol Kiyeon are picking up.

On April 3 the company won an order for Hyundai Steel's blast-furnace PCI facility. Contracted at 19.63 billion won, it is the largest order in the company's history and is regarded as a foothold for continued participation in Hyundai Steel's facility investment projects. On April 10 a contract was also signed for the rationalization of the mini-mill electric arc furnace at Gwangyang Works, worth 7.54 billion won; the company plans to complete the project successfully and expand into external electric-furnace fabrication.

In March the company also won a 6.25 billion won order for roof-top solar power generation on the No. 4 cold rolling product warehouse at Gwangyang Works, supplying engineering, procurement and construction as a package. As Korea's first MW-class roof-top installation, it is expected to lead the technology in this field.

ss-standard.intro: Manufactured to KS B 6370 (JIS B 8354), designed for high performance with a simple structure. The cover shape is square, and depending on stroke length there are two fixing methods: tie-rod fixing or tube-flange fixing.
features: Special rod and tube materials (stainless steel, heat treatment, etc.)

ss-leadswitch.intro: The cylinder tube is stainless steel and the piston is a bronze alloy (BC); the piston packing uses a combination seal. A magnet is inserted in the piston so the stroke can be adjusted simply by the detection of switches mounted on the tie rods. Both covers are square and fixed by tie rods.
features: Special rod and tube materials (stainless steel, heat treatment, etc.)

sl-position.intro: A cylinder designed for position control by simply mounting an LVDT inside; it can be connected directly to a computer or PLC. Repeat position error is small, there is no mechanical backlash at all, and being non-contact its service life is semi-permanent.
features: Special rod and tube materials (stainless steel, heat treatment, etc.)

sm-square-mill.intro: Designed and manufactured to JOHS 110 (Japan hydraulic & pneumatic association standard for steel-mill hydraulic cylinders). Bronze (AlBC3) is weld-deposited on the piston guide to raise bearing-pressure strength, giving excellent durability and reduced sliding friction. Port structure can be taper thread, parallel thread or hydraulic flange. Both covers are square, in a heavy-duty design thicker than the SS140H series; tube-flange fixing is standard, with tie-rod fixing available by service conditions.
features: Special rod and tube materials (stainless steel, heat treatment, etc.)

sm-round-mill.intro: A heavy-duty cylinder for harsh service such as steel-mill machinery. Head and rod covers are round and fixed by tube flange. Bronze (AlBC3) is weld-deposited on the piston guide to raise bearing-pressure strength, giving excellent durability and reduced sliding friction. Port structure can be taper thread, parallel thread or hydraulic flange.
features: Special rod and tube materials (stainless steel, heat treatment, etc.)

sh-vehicle.intro: Both head and rod covers are round; the head cover is welded and the rod cover is screw-assembled. The port is welded to the tube in a simple structure, mainly used for vehicles.
features: Special rod and tube materials (stainless steel, heat treatment, etc.)

st-telescopic.intro: Installed where a long stroke is required in an axially confined space. Simple in structure, with welded support parts; the port can be located anywhere, so support type and port position must be discussed in advance.

sr-ram.intro: A ram-type cylinder delivering high force for presses and similar equipment. Simple in structure and used vertically, it comes in two designs — with or without a rod stopper. The rod end has a female thread for fixing, and high-pressure or large cylinders can be manufactured.

ss-pneumatic.intro: A pneumatic cylinder with square rod-side and head-side covers, fixed by tie rods. Packing material and shape differ depending on lubricated or non-lubricated service.
features: Special rod and tube materials (stainless steel, heat treatment, etc.)

ss-largebore.intro: A pneumatic cylinder with round rod-side and head-side covers, fixed by multiple tie rods — a heavy-duty pneumatic cylinder with cushion devices on both rod and head sides as standard.
features: Up to Ø200 mm (based on outer tube bore)
Special rod and tube materials (stainless steel, heat treatment, etc.)

siteContent.greeting_body:
Since our founding in 1998, SAMICK H&P has led the domestic hydraulic and pneumatic cylinder field through continuous research and development, contributing greatly to factory automation. From ultra-small to ultra-large, we develop and manufacture cylinders exactly to the customer's application.

SAMICK H&P cylinders deliver outstanding performance under any conditions. Every cylinder ships only after strict performance testing on the latest test equipment, guaranteeing high safety, durability and reliability. With carefully selected raw materials and a wide range of machining technologies, we devote ourselves to excellent products and never stop researching new production methods.

Under our management philosophy — quality first, substance in management, trust in transactions, harmony in the organization — every member of SAMICK H&P promises to do their best to be the company customers trust most.
